cast.design: A gravelly, weathered man in his late fifties with a warm Cork Irish accent, low and dry, a smoker's rasp.
cast.style: Dry and unimpressed, but not unkind to a new recruit.
cast.sample: So you're the new apprentice. Welcome aboard. You're in Blue watch, berthed in quarters C. Read the watch bill on the board outside this office: it tells you when you're on, and where you muster.
